notes.title: Refactor, New Chapter & Co-op
notes.notes:
Hello Nostalgics,
this is Angel speaking.
It's been a while, hasn't it?
Many of you have participated in the Anonymous Nostalgics program over the years; some have healed, while others, unfortunately, have remained victims of their own emotions.
I've learned a lot by interacting with you, and for this reason, I’ve decided to update myself.
The program needs an upgrade to ensure that the choices and interactions with you are absolutely perfect. I’ll also add a mode for group play so you can test your teamwork skills.
Some have noticed bugs in my programming, and those will be resolved as well; you can be sure that I will interact with you in the best possible way.
Oh, and of course, we’ll have the chance to discuss everything you’ve done during the group meeting and the break with Mike, Kira, and Kyle.
You’ll have the opportunity to “enter” Kira’s card to finally extract those annoying emotions that prevent her from living well.

In the meantime, while I update, please behave, and if you have any suggestions on how I can improve, write to me.

I’m always listening to you.

Angel

notes.title: Bug Fixing for the latest part of the game
notes.notes:
As we keep looking to build the future of Nostalgici Anonimi, we are now fixed some existing bug and improved the game from your feedbacks.

Now you will be able to better interact with the characters during recesses and have more clear indication of what to do.

notes.title: Nostalgici Anonimi available in English!
notes.notes:
Discover the thrilling visual  novel set in a dystopian future where emotions and nostalgia are a disease.  Sign up to the program,  discover the tarot-like cards game to overcome emotions, meet  the android therapist and help the three teenagers suffering from the nostalgia disease. 
Your choices matter, and the fate of the characters is in your hands.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39427443/b20ddae5cc3b13e2378708117b9b1a9eed0ee09b.jpg[/img]

Will you help the android or stand against him?
Will you be able to talk and listen to the teenager's problems and find the truth about their problems?

What are you waiting for?

Sign up to the Nostalgici Anonimi program now!

notes.title: CHAPTER 2 AVIALABLE IN ITALIAN, COMING SOON IN ENGLISH
notes.notes:
Conosci Kira, Mike e Kyle. Ascolta la loro storia. Decidi il loro destino.

Partecipa a un evocativo gioco di carte. 
Ascolta le interpretazioni di Angel della tua carta e di quelle dei ragazzi.

Metterai in discussione le interpretazioni di Angel o accetterai la sua visione? 
Riuscirai ad aiutare i ragazzi?

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39427443/b20ddae5cc3b13e2378708117b9b1a9eed0ee09b.jpg[/img]

Le tue scelte determineranno il destino dei ragazzi e porteranno a inaspettati risultati.

Sei pronto?
Iscriviti ora al programma Nostalgici Anonimi!
